system.description:
A psychic lobotomy of sorts — the Malkavian strips away a victim's reasoning, reducing him to a childlike state. Requires eye contact with the victim.

MET System: After establishing eye contact, win a Mental Challenge against the subject. Each Mental Trait you expend (up to seven) permanently tears away one of the subject's Mental Traits for the rest of the night — lost Traits cannot be regained by Willpower or similar means, only restored the following night. The victim also gains the Regression derangement for as long as the childlike state lasts. Duration scales with successes/Traits committed, from one turn up to a year or more at Storyteller discretion.
